title: Update to Marvelous Designer 2025.2: Unlock New Tools and Improved Efficiency!
content:
![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/72dc41ae787147dfaeaa79278b2be924/images/005b624ef6a741408085531790fec04cSocial%20Media%202025.2%20EN.png)![b5f95b96bf544c50b17b506bc75cb74b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202511/72dc41ae787147dfaeaa79278b2be924/images/b5f95b96bf544c50b17b506bc75cb74bSocial%20Media%202025.2%20EN%20%281%29.png)

_Update Marvelous Designer to version 2025.2_

**More Options, Greater Control.**  
**Upgrade your workflow with 5 powerful new features designed to enhance realism, efficiency, and creative expression.**

🎥 [Watch the Overview Video](https://youtu.be/mNiP-vMqExs?si=VrzrozdKfWEL3gWt)

📚 [Explore the Tutorials](https://www.youtube.com/@Marvelousdesigner)

* * *

# **Key Features**

**Convert Patterns to Trims and Accessories**

Patterns can now be converted into trims or avatar accessories. This expands artists’ abilities to customize their designs, improve file performance, and easily create accessories to swap between avatars of the same type.

**MetaHuman DNA Importer**

Enhance the realism of your MetaHumans in DNA format by importing them directly into Marvelous Designer for realistic garment creation.

**Keyable Properties Expansion**

New animation upgrades let users keyframe pressure, shrinkage, tack, line tack, and trim weight, opening up endless possibilities for simulation and animation.

**EveryWear Export with FBX**

We’re giving you more control over your workflow and greater offline usability by enabling FBX files to be exported directly to local storage without going through CONNECT.

**Pleat Creation Tool**

Creating pleats for your garments has never been easier. The new pleats tool allows you to easily experiment with different styles of pleats quickly and easily without the need for time-consuming manual adjustment.

* * *

# **The Future of Marvelous Designer is Here.**

From drafting a pattern to applying the final details, update 2025.2 offers new creative features and speeds up the process at the same time.

➡️ [Download the update now](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/product/download)
